'''Victor Jun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who suffered from [[schizophrenia]], and he thought the voices in his head were those of gods and obeyed what they told him to do&mdash;which occasionally involved murder&mdash;and in turn, the gods gave him glimpses into their power. In reality, these "glimpses" were Jun using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].
